summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the employer tuition assistance, workforce-training, and career-pathway platform node. The strongest direct reference name is Strategic Education because its public materials explicitly describe a wholly owned tuition assistance platform, employer partnerships, accredited degrees, non-degree skill pathways, and coding schools. Grand Canyon Education, Stride, and Nelnet enter the underfollowed lane as plausible public-market mappings: GCE through employer/education agreements and workforce-aligned university services; Stride through career learning, professional skills training, and talent development; Nelnet through education technology services, payments, and systems infrastructure that may sit adjacent to tuition-benefit administration.
